newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian export prices rise 2.2 pct in June.
newsitem.headline: Australian export prices rise 2.2 pct in June.

text.p: Australian export prices rose 2.2 percent in June from the previous month and were 1.9 percent higher than a year earlier, the Australian Bureau of Statistics said on Friday.
"Further depreciation of the Australian dollar against the major trading currencies was a major contributor to the increase," the bureau said.
The monthly increase was the largest rise for more than 15 months and the annual increase was the first rise in more than 15 months.
The index stood at 94.9 in June, still well below the base of 100 in 1989/90.
